class _State(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [(k, ctypes.c_double) for k in _D] + [(k, ctypes.c_int) for k in _I]


assert ctypes.sizeof(_State) == 0xc0

_lib = ctypes.CDLL(os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), "arp_priv.so"))
_fn = ctypes.cast(_lib.ARNAUD_dnaupd, ctypes.c_void_p).value
_drv = ctypes.CDLL(os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), "drv.so"))

_drv.run.restype = ctypes.c_int


def _ptr(a):
    return a.ctypes.data


_B = 8
_NT = int(os.environ.get('SPMV_NT', '4'))


def _ell(N, indptr, indices, data):
    nb = (N + _B - 1) // _B
    rl = np.diff(indptr)
    rlp = np.zeros(nb * _B, dtype=np.int64)
    rlp[:N] = rl
    blen = rlp.reshape(nb, _B).max(axis=1).astype(np.int32)
    off = np.zeros(nb, dtype=np.int32)
    off[1:] = np.cumsum(blen)[:-1]
    tot = int(blen.sum())
    col = np.zeros(tot * _B, dtype=np.int32)
    val = np.zeros(tot * _B, dtype=np.float64)
    rows = np.repeat(np.arange(N), rl)
    pos = np.arange(len(indices)) - indptr[rows]
    b = rows // _B
    l = rows % _B
    idx = (off[b].astype(np.int64) + pos) * _B + l
    col[idx] = indices
    val[idx] = data
    return nb, off, blen, col, val

        indices = np.ascontiguousarray(A.indices, dtype=np.int32)
        data = np.ascontiguousarray(A.data, dtype=np.float64)
